g.text: The mobile is in a call on Cell A
It measures neighbour cells every 480 ms
Reports go to the BSC through Cell A
Signal A falls while signal B rises
MS reports signal levels of the serving and neighbour cells
BSC sees Cell B better than Cell A by the hysteresis margin
Target BTS allocates a traffic channel
Network tells the MS the new frequency and time slot
MS tunes to Cell B and sends handover access bursts
Cell A frees its channel, call continues on Cell B
New link set before dropping old
